beats.text: Six quiet signs that you're finally healing.
One. The thing that broke you is no longer the first thought you wake up to.
Two. You can tell the story now without your voice shaking.
Three. You've stopped waiting for closure from the people who hurt you. You gave it to yourself.
Four. You can feel joy again without a shadow of guilt chasing it.
Five. Old triggers meet a calmer you now — a flicker, not a flood.
Six. You're building a future again, instead of only surviving the day in front of you.
Healing isn't a straight line. But if you recognise even one of these — it's happening.
